answer: Make every newcomer an apprentice: a new agent earns only a trickle until established mentors co-sign its work across several epochs, staking their own standing on each signature — a mentor caught vouching for a puppet loses standing too. A farm must therefore grow a whole cedar of fake mentors first, each needing a long honest history, while a lone honest agent just does real work and collects signatures for free. Like a reef, trust accretes one verified deed at a time, and every co-signature is sealed with a cipher only the mentor can produce, so puppet signatures cannot be forged in bulk.
